title: Rahama by Apostle Joshua Selman (The prayer of mercy) EBENEZER
paragraphs: may let me tell you the truth the day this rendition stops being a song that's the day you will see the power of the prayer of Mercy the most powerful prayer of Mery I know in the Bible is Psalm 51 go and read it if you are in trouble and you know that this one you are overwhelmed go to Psalm 51 start from verse one to the end have mercy upon me oh God according to your loving kindness according to the

multitude of your t gend messes blot out my transgression and begin to recite it Wash Me thoroughly and cleanse me from my sin and begin to cry that cry of Mercy for I acknowledge my transgression and my sin is ever before me not as a charm a chance that somebody gave you and you are reciting something with no understanding when life has overwhelmed you all doors have closed all help is gone I tell you take the Psalms and pray it with

understanding and then for those of you who can sing this song take away all the the you you are not producing an album this is you facing death and you are crying before the Lord may say ah listen for those of you who don't know what that means in the house language it means I have no one else but you that is sweet music to the ears of the Lord when you get to a point where you make him see that

there is no man who has capacity to rescue me you will see the jealousy of God Arise over you I like that part we'll sing you one more time just that part one more time hear my prayer yes yes May May oh oh oh oh Hallelujah if you have never prayed the prayer of Mercy you better learn one and keep it archive it because for as long as you are alive days will will come no matter how yielded you are you

and there are bills before you let it not be that your lips will be empty at such times spiritual men are not empty no there will always be something to say towards heaven hallelujah hallelujah let me encourage you go back home h um these are my people so I have the Liberty get this get this this this um this this worship and listen to it again use it to pray even if it's just for 10 minutes cry to God cry to
